description.text:
Challenge Hiroba (ポケモンチャレンジひろば, Pokémon Challenge Plaza) were free card game events held from 2008 to 2010 in shopping malls and department stores across Japan, to reach new players beyond the card shops of the Official Gyms. They had teaching corners, lotteries, free battles, trading corners and Card Get Battles (カードゲットバトル), small tournaments played until a player lost, up to five rounds.

In 2008 they mostly handed out earlier promos again. From 2009 each month brought a new card for players, five straight Card Get Battle wins won a silver Victory Medal, and each new expansion had launch battles, shared with the gyms' Gym Challenge, whose cards carry its logo. The events were phased out in 2010, after the last LEGEND expansion, as the Black & White era arrived.
